gloss: cleanup; tidying up afterwards; putting things away

definitions.gloss: cleanup; tidying up afterwards; putting things away
definitions.explanation: the work of cleaning up and putting things back in order after an activity, event, or meal

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{後片付|あとかたづ}けをする。
examples.english: I'll clean up after the meal.

examples.japanese: パーティーの{後片付|あとかたづ}けに{二時間|にじかん}かかった。
examples.english: It took two hours to clean up after the party.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちに{遊|あそ}んだ{後|あと}の{後片付|あとかたづ}けを{教|おし}えるのは{大切|たいせつ}なことだ。
examples.english: Teaching children to tidy up after playing is an important thing.

notes:
Refers specifically to the cleanup that follows an activity — distinct from general housekeeping. The word emphasizes returning things to their original state after use. Very common in domestic and workplace contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食事|しょくじ}の{後片付|あとかたづ}け: cleanup after a meal
- {後片付|あとかたづ}けをする: to do the cleanup
- {後片付|あとかたづ}けを{手伝|てつだ}う: to help with cleanup
- {後片付|あとかたづ}けが{大変|たいへん}: the cleanup is a lot of work
- イベントの{後片付|あとかたづ}け: cleanup after an event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {片付|かたづ}け: tidying up — general organizing/putting away, not specifically "after" something
- {掃除|そうじ}: cleaning — broader cleaning (sweeping, wiping), not about putting things back
- {撤収|てっしゅう}: removal/packing up — more formal, used for events, equipment, military

WORD FORMATION:
{後|あと} (after) + {片付|かたづ}け (tidying). The {後|あと} specifies that this is cleanup following a specific activity.
